before: ["topic" => "stars"] associates a string key with a value. => separates key and value in an array entry.
A valid decimal integer string such as "8" is converted to integer key 8. A leading-zero string such as "08" remains a string key.
If two entries resolve to the same key, the later value replaces the earlier one rather than adding a second entry.
